description.value: King Taps is a multi-location Canadian restaurant and bar chain with a Langley outpost in the Willowbrook area, serving 40+ draft taps of regional and international craft beers alongside handmade pizzas and Italian-inspired North American food. The space includes an all-season patio and expansive lounge suited to groups and events, with weekend brunch service also on offer. Touring cyclists will find a lively full-service stop with online ordering and a full bar program anchored by locally sourced brews.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 96m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms King Taps Langley at 6141 200th St, Langley, BC (matching OSM address) and the site is clearly active with current promotions including FIFA World Cup 2026 reservations. The 'Order Now' feature is prominently displayed across the site, confirming takeout/online ordering availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields are null.
